fields.statement: QA at 8f0616278 with the built tools/release binary, real git against a scratch clone and bare origin, a fake gh (CI and release list/create only) and the real root daemon. The real log has bug requests within the last 24h, so the soak gate failed there. On a scratch commit that drops them, check showed v0.2.0 minor with every gate passing. cut then pushed an annotated v0.2.0 at the candidate. Its tag object carries all 5 '## ' headings (Breaking changes and the milestones), the cycle-1 failure, now fixed. release.yml's notes step, run verbatim in a fresh clone, printed annotated=true and wrote release-notes.md with the 5 headings. A repeat cut printed 'none: no release since v0.2.0' and left origin unchanged. With CI failing it printed the ci FAIL gate and 'v0.2.0 is blocked', and no tag existed locally or on origin. record-run against the live daemon appended {commit dbb826dd..., at 2026-11-12T20:16:37Z}. A second run added nothing. With no -runs and RHIZA_RELEASE_RUNS empty, it exited 1 with 'no run history file'. systemd-analyze --user verify accepts both units, and agents/vm.md names rhiza-release.timer. go test -run 'TestCut|TestRecordDaemonRun|TestMajor' passed.

QA at 8f0616278 with the built tools/release binary, real git with a scratch clone and bare origin, and a fake gh. The last release was an annotated v1.0.0, with breaking changes since. The first cut drafted one GitHub release, v2.0.0 at the candidate (gh release create --draft --target), and pushed no tag. With the draft reported, a second cut created no new draft and pushed nothing. Next I simulated the owner's sign-off: a lightweight v2.0.0 at the candidate on origin, with gh release list reporting it published. cut printed 'v2.0.0 is signed off by the owner' and 'tagged and pushed v2.0.0'. Origin's v2.0.0 is now an annotated tag object at the candidate with all 5 '## ' headings. That fixes the cycle-1 failure, where the lightweight tag was taken as the last release. A repeat cut printed 'none: no release since v2.0.0' and left origin's tag unchanged. Exactly one draft was created in total.
